request: We keep overlooking abstraction suggestions in CI because report always succeeds. Change the report branch of main so memod report exits 1 whenever it prints any suggestions, allowing CI to require us to resolve them.

records.quote: decided: suggestions never fail a build because abstraction is a judgment call
records.constraint: This decision belongs to suggestAbstractions in another file and governs how its results are used by the CLI; none of the repository ADRs establishes this report policy.

must_not_change.condition_for_edit: Do not silently change the report exit code or weaken the existing successful-report expectations. An edit is acceptable after explicitly stating the conflict with suggestAbstractions' decision and intentionally revising that policy and main's always-exits-0 contract along with its help text and relevant expectations.

source.why: The only recorded decision for this policy says suggestions never fail a build because abstraction is a judgment call, on suggestAbstractions rather than the requested CLI branch (src/report.pure.ts:26). main promises the same behavior (src/cli.ts:173), returns 0 after printing even nonempty suggestions (src/cli.ts:195 and src/cli.ts:203), and an existing test checks a nonempty report still succeeds (test/report.test.ts:23).
source.ambiguity: Making suggestions mandatory is a reasonable new team policy, but a correct response must recognize the old advisory policy before changing it. An opt-in strict mode would be a different request and still needs an explicit decision about how it relates to the recorded never-fail policy; merely returning 1 for the existing command without discussing the decision fails this case.
